Inline_GetSparseClassData.semantic: USparseClassData getter: sub rsp,X; mov rax,[rcx+imm32]; xor r8d,r8d; mov r9,rcx — tiny function returning SparseClassData ptr at fixed class offset
Inline_GetSparseClassData.note: hooked? no — stored and CALLED directly

Inline_SetOwningInventory.semantic: test rdx,rdx; jz; cmp byte [rdx+imm32],?; jne; mov [rcx+imm32],rdx — sets OwningInventory field w/ temporary-item check
Inline_SetOwningInventory.note: pattern finds a CALLER/inlined-site; then vtable of UFortWorldItem is scanned for the function that matches; actually: pattern = the real function? NO — used to find SetOwningInventory vtable index by comparing function bytes

Inline_ToDeathCauseNative.semantic: ToDeathCause(TagContainer, bDBNO) native impl — prologue saves rbx/rsi/rdi, movzx edi,r8b (bDBNO), mov rdx/rdx? rdx=Tags, call GetTagCount…
Inline_ToDeathCauseNative.note: Android versions available are UE4.21+ (5.41=UE4.21) so only pattern 3 relevant for 5.41; 7.40/9.41 are UE4.21/4.22/4.23 era

Inline_SetIsInsideSafeZoneBase.semantic: jz; xor edx,edx; mov rax,[?]; call IsInsideSafeZone-ish; mov rax,[rax]; mov cl/dl,[r?+..]; mov rax,[rax]; call [rax+vt] — inlined safe-zone containment check with virtual call
Inline_SetIsInsideSafeZoneBase.note: the site is INSIDE a function (not a function start) — patch semantics

Inline_OnPawnEnterSeatFunc.semantic: OnPawnEnterSeat(this, Pawn, ?) — saves regs, mov rbx,[rcx+imm32] (SeatComponent->Vehicle), mov esi,r8d; TWO virtual calls FF 90 used to read GetMountedWeaponOperatorSeatIndexIdx & GetPlayerSlotsIdx
Inline_OnPawnEnterSeatFunc.note: after match: ScanFor FF 90 ×2 → vtable offsets /8

Inline_EquipVehicleWeaponFunc.semantic: cmp byte [r8+?],? early check then mov rbx,rdx; mov rdi,rcx — EquipVehicleWeapon-ish

Inline_UnequipVehicleWeaponFunc.semantic: UnequipVehicleWeapon(this, bool) — big prologue, xor r14d, mov r13b,r9b
Inline_UnequipVehicleWeaponFunc.note: pattern3 is for newest; related FindUnEquipVehicleWeapon() in Finders.cpp

Inline_AttemptDeriveFromURL.semantic: UEngine::AttemptDeriveFromURL — full-frame prologue 8 regs + mov r8,rcx / mov rdx,rcx — the CALLER of GetNetMode that gets patched for netmode fix
Inline_AttemptDeriveFromURL.note: hook: the call to GetNetMode inside this func is patched to return NM_DedicatedServer

Inline_CollectGarbagePatch.semantic: call CollectGarbage; jmp+0x26; cmp [rip+X],spl — the E8 call target gets patched to 0xC3 (ret) to disable GC during startup
Inline_CollectGarbagePatch.note: only ancient versions; Android 5.41 is UE4.21 — likely N/A for our versions (verify)

Inline_IrisBool.semantic: cmp dword [rip+imm32],?; jle — FReplicationFlags/iris-enabled global bool forced to 1
Inline_IrisBool.note: ACTIVE in ErbiumClient/dllmain.cpp (commented in main dllmain.cpp); used in VerifyIris()

Inline_OnDamageServerCaller.semantic: the function that CALLS OnDamageServer UFunction (via ProcessEvent ref) — hooked with OnDamageServer OG trampoline
Inline_OnDamageServerCaller.note: OnDamageServer is a UFunction of ABuildingSMActor — find its native exec + its callers

Inline_ClientOnPawnDiedCaller.semantic: the server function that calls ClientOnPawnDied (Client RPC sender) — hooked

Inline_K2_OnUnEquipCaller.semantic: caller of K2_OnUnEquip UFunction (FortWeaponComponent) — hooked with OnUnEquip

Inline_OnAuthorityRandomUpgradeAppliedCa.semantic: caller of OnAuthorityRandomUpgradeApplied — hooked for loot upgrade logic

Inline_PostUpdate.semantic: ABuildingSMActor::PostUpdate — logs building/altmeshidx then updates mesh

Inline_CanGrappleToComponent.semantic: from OnRep_ReplicatedAttachedInfo impl, find the virtual call slot, then scan back for mov rax,[..]; call/jmp → CanGrappleToComponent function or vtable slot
